policy.generator: uint32 LCG: state=(1664525*state+1013904223)%2**32; u=state/2**32; return updated state first
policy.sources: Bernoulli u<p/100, uniform u in [0,1), exponential -log1p(-u); p has at most two decimal places
policy.moments: Population mean/variance exact Fraction strings; empirical variance uses denominator repetitions
policy.lln: 1..4000 trials, actual ordered prefix sums; errorIncreases counts strict increases of absolute error
policy.clt: n=1..100, repetitions=10..1000; continuously consumed stream; dependent repeats one draw within each block
policy.standardization: z=sqrt(n)*(mean-populationMean)/sigma; null for zero variance; dependent still uses iid scale for comparison
policy.histogram: 24 bins [-4,4), width=8/24; floor((z+4)/width), capped at 23 only for z<4; underflow z<-4, overflow z>=4
policy.density: count/(repetitions*width); tails retain their mass, no in-window renormalization
policy.fixtureArrays: First min(trials,24) LLN prefixes; first min(repetitions,24) CLT sums/means/z; first three complete blocks; aggregate summaries cover whole run
policy.numericalTolerance: 2e-12*max(1,abs(expected)) for binary64 arithmetic/log cross-language comparisons; counts and LCG uniforms exact
policy.statisticalError: No guaranteed realized error or Gaussian fit; sigma/sqrt(m) is theoretical iid mean SD, not a confidence guarantee
policy.dependentCounterexample: Within-block dependence gives Var(mean)=population variance, instead of variance/n; CLT assumptions violated
